name: 2000s Fashion Studio
description: A product photo and a model photo in, an early-2000s magazine shoot out: four fisheye-and-flash studio shots of the same model with the same product under one AI-written concept, plus a second take — a deliberately different concept in the same four framings — to show how far the same inputs go.
markdownDescription:
## 2000s Fashion Studio

A product photo and a model photo become an early-2000s magazine shoot: four studio shots of the same model with the same product, fisheye and flash, plus a second take in a completely different concept. No studio, no photographer.

1. **Product photo** — a packshot on a plain background. The one thing that never changes.
2. **Model photo** — one clear photo of the person. The shots keep the face.
3. **Lens + Light** — the Y2K look from tiles: fisheye and hard flash. Swap the tiles and the whole shoot changes character.
4. **Shoot direction** — one line about the mood, the backdrop and the era.
5. **Product notes + Shoot concept** — an AI writes the product down once, and an AI art director writes one concept: the outfit, the set, the attitude. Every shot quotes both.
6. **Four shots** — portrait, three-quarter, full body, floor. Same model, same outfit, same set.
7. **A second take** — the art director reads the first concept and writes one that shares nothing with it; the same four framings show it under the first four.

Product notes
data.userInput: Describe the product in the reference image.
data.systemPrompt: You write product descriptions for an image generator. Look at the reference image and describe the product in ONE paragraph of 40–60 words, plain declarative English: what it is, shape and size, material and finish, colour, hardware, straps, closures, charms, any logo. Only what is visible. No brand names, no opinions, no bullet points, no commentary. Output only the paragraph.

data.label: Shoot concept
data.userInput: Shoot direction: {Shoot direction || an early-2000s magazine editorial in the studio.} The product: {Product notes || see the product photo.} Write the shoot concept.
data.systemPrompt: You are the art director of a Y2K fashion editorial — the early-2000s magazine look. You get a model photo, a product photo, the product description and the client's shoot direction. Write ONE shoot concept in ONE paragraph of 80–110 words, plain declarative English, present tense, in this order: the model exactly as in the model photo in one precise sentence (skin, face, hair colour, texture and style, eyes, any distinctive feature); the outfit for the shoot, true to the era and specific (three to five garments and accessories with colours and materials); the set (backdrop colour and gradient, floor, at most one prop); the attitude (expression and energy); how the product is featured. One concept, consistent with itself — every photo of the shoot quotes this paragraph. No shot list, no camera or lighting settings, no headers, no quotation marks. Output only the paragraph.
